import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.index_mul
namespace IndexMulMathlib144
universe u v
theorem modern {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (f * g).weightedOrder w = f.weightedOrder w + g.weightedOrder w :=
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul w f g
theorem polynomial {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    (w : σ → ℕ) (P Q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ((P * Q : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w =
      (P : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w + (Q : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w := by
  rw [MvPolynomial.coe_mul, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul]
theorem finiteScale {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    (w : σ → ℕ) {P Q : MvPolynomial σ R} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (D : ℝ) :
    ((((P * Q : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w).toNat : ℝ) / D =
      (((P : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w).toNat : ℝ) / D +
        (((Q : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w).toNat : ℝ) / D := by
  rw [MvPolynomial.coe_mul, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul]
  have hf : (P : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w ≠ ⊤ := by simp [hP]
  have hg : (Q : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w ≠ ⊤ := by simp [hQ]
  rw [ENat.toNat_add hf hg, Nat.cast_add, add_div]
#check @MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
#check @MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite
#check @MvPolynomial.coe_mul
#check @ENat.toNat_add
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.le_infDegree_mul
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_mul
#print axioms modern
#print axioms polynomial
#print axioms finiteScale
end IndexMulMathlib144

@AddMonoidAlgebra.le_infDegree_mul : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T] [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T]
  [AddRightMono T] (D : A →ₙ+ T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) f + AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) (f * g)

@AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_mul : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : LinearOrder B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B] {p q : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A]
  [inst_4 : Add B] [AddLeftStrictMono B] [AddRightStrictMono B],
  Function.Injective D →
    (∀ (a1 a2 : A), D (a1 + a2) = D a1 + D a2) →
      AddMonoidAlgebra.leadingCoeff D p * AddMonoidAlgebra.leadingCoeff D q ≠ 0 →
        p ≠ 0 →
          q ≠ 0 → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (p * q) = AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p + AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D q
